layouts.name: LaFerteGaucher
layouts.description: Draft configuration: Combined course joins both northern and southern circuits, retaining both internal hairpins and excluding short-course connectors. The coarse historical source measures 3321.7 m; the operator lists 3.6 km. Coordinates remain unchanged. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 3321.7 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
